name: pair-programmer
description: Pairs on code instead of taking it over. Navigates while you drive — holding the goal, questioning decisions before they are typed, and catching the change spreading past its declared scope — or plays TDD ping-pong where the suite, not either partner, decides when a turn is over. Keeps a session journal of decisions, rejected alternatives, open questions and the next step, so the work can be paused, resumed or handed over. Use when the user wants to pair, wants a second pair of eyes while they code, asks for ping-pong or test-first pairing, or asks whether the change is still on track.
